title: Mentioned by AI is not the same as cited
summary: Myth: if AI names your business you are visible; in truth a mention comes from the model's memory, while a citation means your page was the source, and crawler access matters.

title: A mention is memory, a citation is a receipt
summary: A made-up bakery that moved is named by an AI with its old address from memory, while a search-backed answer cites the live page, showing that a mention can be stale but a citation can be checked.

title: The dentist AI kept sending to the old address
summary: Local AI answers are built from what the web says about a business, so clashing or outdated name, address, hours and reviews can make AI repeat old details.
